facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up about 1.03% of the value of Niger's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at about 1.03% of the value of Niger's 480,220 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel says the BCEAO lists 13 participants in Niger authorised to open PI-SPI services to the public, as of 30 September 2026.
